parameters.note: Upper Velma Lake is a high alpine lake in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.). Its outlet forms the headwaters of Eagle Creek, which drops over Eagle Falls into Emerald Bay, so it sits in the Lake Tahoe basin. However, the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure in §7.50(b)(152)(A) reaches only 'Tahoe Lake tributaries upstream to the first lake' — on the Eagle Creek drainage the first lake is Eagle Lake, well below Upper Velma — so that closure does not extend up to the lake itself. Upper Velma Lake is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
